The Smart Grill People Can’t Stop Talking About!

Renowned media outlet People Magazine recently featured the Monument Grills Eminence 605, calling it “one of the must-have barbecue essentials of 2025.” The magazine highlighted its smart technology, outstanding performance, and durable design as key reasons why it stands out.

According to People, this eight-burner, full-stainless steel smart grill is a top choice for outdoor cooking enthusiasts. It features Eminence Smart Control App integration, allowing users to remotely adjust temperature settings, timers, and cooking modes via Bluetooth. The intelligent display, designed for easy readability even in direct sunlight, also connects to a meat thermometer for precise grilling. Additionally, the grill boasts a high-powered infrared sear station and rear burner, ensuring fast heating and even cooking.

In terms of durability, People praises the weatherproof stainless steel construction, designed to withstand harsh outdoor conditions. The grill also offers dual gas compatibility (propane and natural gas) and spacious storage solutions, including a hidden garbage bin holder for added convenience.

Beyond the Eminence 605, People also recommends other models in the Eminence series, such as the Eminence 405 and Eminence 425, catering to different grilling needs.

Powerful, Spacious, and Packed with Premium Features

GOOD HOUSEKEEPING recently highlighted a new gas grill from Monument in their early review, noting its impressive performance and high-end features at a surprising price point. During initial testing, the team was impressed with how evenly the grill heated bread and how well it handled cooking steak and chicken, delivering strong, consistent heat across the entire surface.

This Eminence 605 offers a generous 640 square inches of primary cooking space and includes a powerful side burner specifically designed for searing. It also comes equipped with a rotisserie attachment and a rear infrared burner—features the reviewers typically associate with higher-end models. They also pointed out the digital control panel that connects to a smartphone as a thoughtful, modern touch that adds to the overall grilling experience.

Additional highlights included the spacious storage area beneath the grill and a built-in waste basket, both of which contribute to a more convenient and organized outdoor cooking setup. GOOD HOUSEKEEPING expressed excitement about seeing how the grill performs in further testing and sees it as a promising option for those who want both power and versatility in a backyard grill.

A Top Pick for Power, Size, and Smart Grilling in 2025

CNET has named Monument's newest flagship grill the best overall grill of 2025. They praise its impressive six-burner Eminence 605 setup and expansive 860 square inches of cooking space, calling it ideal for large families or anyone hosting big gatherings. Designed with power and versatility in mind, it’s a grill built to handle serious outdoor cooking.

What sets this model apart, according to CNET, is the combination of smart technology and thoughtful design. It features built-in temperature probes that sync with a mobile app, allowing users to monitor cooking progress remotely. The dedicated rear infrared burner paired with a rotisserie adds new cooking dimensions, perfect for roasting whole chickens or kebabs evenly. A powerful searing station on the side makes it easy to grill vegetables and finish meats with a perfect char.

CNET highlights this grill as a top pick for enthusiasts who value both performance and innovation. With quick preheating, precision control, and high-capacity output, it’s described as the ideal choice for anyone serious about grilling in 2025.

The High-Tech Grill Everyone’s Raving About!


Bob Vila, a trusted authority in home improvement, has highlighted Monument Grills' new Eminence series as a top choice for grill masters looking to upgrade their outdoor cooking setup. According to their review, the Eminence grills not only enhance the flavor and efficiency of grilling but also bring a new level of convenience with modern smart features.

A key reason for Bob Vila’s recommendation is the Eminence 605’s advanced technology, including a color LED touchscreen, Bluetooth connectivity, and a mobile app that allows users to monitor temperatures, set timers, and control burners from up to 65 feet away. Additionally, the powerful 89,000 BTU output, infrared sear burners, and stainless steel rotisserie provide professional-grade versatility for various cooking styles.

Durability is another standout feature. Bob Vila notes that Monument Grills engineered the Eminence series to withstand extreme weather, thanks to premium stainless steel construction, waterproof seals, and rigorous testing. The IPX8-rated control panel ensures reliability even in heavy rain, and the 10-year limited warranty further underscores its longevity.

For those seeking a high-performance, weather-resistant grill with cutting-edge convenience, Bob Vila recognizes Monument Grills as a leading choice in outdoor cooking.

Must-Have Smart Grill for Summer


FOOD & WINE recently reviewed the Monument Grills Eminence 605 and highlighted it as a must-have smart grill for the summer season. According to their review, this grill stands out with its full stainless steel front panel, firebox, and control panel, along with a durable die-cast aluminum side panel, ensuring longevity and weather resistance.

In terms of smart features, the Eminence 605 is equipped with an Upgraded Cinema LED Display, offering precise temperature, lighting, and propane tank level control through its intuitive touch panel. Additionally, users can monitor these settings remotely via the Monument Grills Smart Control App.

FOOD & WINE also praised the high-performance rear infrared burner, side infrared burner, and full Blaze Zone, which allow for faster and more even heating—perfect for achieving the ideal sear. The dual gas compatibility is another key feature, giving users the flexibility to use either propane or natural gas to suit their home setup.

Beyond performance, the Eminence 605 enhances the grilling experience with customizable, color-changing knob lighting, adding ambiance while also serving as a temperature indicator. FOOD & WINE commended Monument Grills for its commitment to quality and durability, emphasizing the 10-year limited warranty offered on the Eminence Series, providing customers with added confidence in their purchase.

The Ultimate Smart Grill for Outdoor Cooking


Dwell magazine highlights Monument Grills’ Eminence 605 as a game-changer for outdoor cooking spaces, blending high performance with sophisticated design. They emphasize that a grill should be more than just a functional tool—it should be the centerpiece of a well-designed outdoor oasis.


Dwell praises the Eminence 605’s sleek stainless steel construction, which pairs beautifully with modern outdoor design elements like wood decking, concrete countertops, and blackened steel accents. They also highlight its smart features, including Bluetooth connectivity and an LED display, which allow for remote control and effortless grilling. Additionally, the dynamic knob lighting system, which changes color based on temperature, enhances both aesthetics and functionality, making the grill a stunning focal point for evening gatherings.


Beyond style and technology, Dwell notes the grill’s all-season durability. With weatherproof seals and rust-resistant materials, the Eminence 605 is built to perform year-round. Paired with thoughtful outdoor design—like strategic lighting, pergolas, and fire features—this grill helps create an inviting space that extends beyond summer cookouts.
For those looking to upgrade their outdoor kitchen with both style and substance, Dwell recommends Monument Grills as the ultimate choice.

Consistent Performance and Excellent Preheat Capability

Consumer Reports has highlighted a new large gas grill from Monument as a top choice for its strong all-around performance and reliability. According to their lab tests, the Denali 605 stood out in key areas including evenness of heating, preheat speed, and indirect cooking capability—making it a solid pick for those who love outdoor grilling.

The grill features six main burners, an electronic ignition system, a side burner, and an LCD digital temperature display, all designed to enhance user control and cooking versatility. It offers 565 square inches of shelf space and is equipped with four casters for easier movement. CR's testing team found that it reached high temperatures quickly during the preheat test and distributed heat evenly across the grill surface. It also performed excellently in indirect cooking, showing it can handle a variety of grilling techniques.

Notably, Consumer Reports mentioned that Monument gas grills earned high predicted reliability and owner satisfaction scores in their member surveys. With advanced features, strong heat control, and a spacious cooking surface, this model is seen as a smart investment for backyard chefs looking for performance and convenience in one package.

Best Gas Grills of 2025 to Become a Backyard BBQ Master

MEN'S JOURNAL recommended the Monument Denali 405, calling it the perfect combination of traditional craftsmanship and cutting-edge technology. This grill features a durable stainless steel build and porcelain-enameled cast iron grates, ensuring excellent heat conduction and long-lasting performance. It also includes the latest tech, such as LED control knobs, a digital thermometer, and a smart LED display screen, allowing for precise temperature control.

The 4-burner grill offers ample cooking space, capable of grilling 28 burgers at once with 60,000 BTUs of heat—ideal for large gatherings or cookouts. One of its standout features is the glass lid, which allows users to check on their food without lifting the lid and losing heat.

Additionally, the Denali 405 is Bluetooth-enabled, so you can control the grill from your phone while relaxing inside. MEN'S JOURNAL praised the grill for its combination of sleek design, powerful performance, and modern technological features, making it an excellent choice for anyone looking to elevate their grilling experience.

settings.text: Monument Grills Serves up a Mountain of Innovation in New Lineup
settings.footer_button_label: Please Read the Terms, Time Left:
settings.custom_text:
Monument Grills Unveils Innovative New Lineup


Forbes has given high praise to Monument Grills’ latest lineup, recognizing its strong innovation and design. As outdoor grilling continues to grow in popularity, the market has become increasingly competitive. Monument Grills has successfully captured consumer attention by introducing high-quality, high-performance gas grills that stand out from the competition.

According to Forbes, Monument Grills’ brand philosophy is inspired by the spirit of mountains, symbolizing durability, innovation, and overcoming challenges. The company’s product names, such as Monument, Mesa, and Denali, reflect its commitment to quality and reliability. Marketing Manager Romiya Welch emphasized that Monument Grills prioritizes customer needs, offering durable and affordable products while maintaining strong relationships with retail partners to ensure excellent service.

In its latest product lineup, Monument Grills has integrated market research and customer feedback to introduce the Clearview Window—a glass viewing panel that allows users to monitor their food without lifting the lid, preserving heat and flavor. Welch explained that the idea stemmed from a desire to let users visually experience the Maillard reaction, ensuring better cooking results.

Forbes believes that with its continuous innovation, superior quality, and customer-focused approach, Monument Grills is establishing itself as a major force in the gas grill industry.

settings.text: Monument Grills Releases the Denali Series for Connected Grilling
settings.footer_button_label: Please Read the Terms, Time Left:
settings.custom_text:
Monument Grills Releases the Denali Series for Connected Grilling

OCBS NEWS has recommended the Monument Grills Denali 605 as the best smart grill for entertaining, highlighting its combination of modern technology and user-friendly design. With 84,000 BTUs of cooking power and 895 square inches of cooking space, this grill is built for large gatherings and is capable of delivering impressive performance.

The Denali 605 stands out with its smart features, allowing you to control the temperature and cooking time directly from your smartphone. This makes it easy to monitor the progress of your food and adjust settings even when you're not standing by the grill. For those who prefer to focus on the cooking process, the built-in LED display provides real-time information, ensuring you don't need to refer to your phone.

In addition to its tech-savvy features, the Denali 605 boasts a clear-view lid, allowing you to visually check your food without losing heat. The porcelain-coated, cast iron cooking grates ensure even heat distribution, resulting in perfectly cooked food every time.

OCBS NEWS praises the Denali 605 not only for its innovative features but also for its ability to simplify grilling, making it an ideal choice for those who want a high-performance grill for entertaining.
